label: MUTABLE_2: a life boundary requires potency, through another's power and a sense bridge
meaning: MUTABLE_2 (THROUGH_ANOTHER) branch of the boundary use: whatever begins or ceases to live is in another being's power, and (explicit sense bridge) whatever is in another's power is in potency in itself; so whatever begins or ceases to live is in potency in itself in some respect, the root-route node. The controls give a model in which the MUTABLE_2 premise holds, the bridge fails and the node fails.

strong_version_needed.473f3a7f-0730-5bdc-a7e2-772c8372ffd7: This is the MUTABLE_2 branch of the fork and keeps its own boundary reading by design; the weaker MUTABLE_3 reading also suffices with the same bridge (LIFE-BOUNDARY-POTENCY-FROM-SOME-MUTABILITY).
